items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: He says, 'Man, I heard Vido taking Hymie Schertzer these solos and / rehearsed him all evening when he's coming in the band...'

ctx.x: Today, if you can't read well, you got to make it as a soloist.

That's the only thing. You got to be a soloist, that's what I told him. I says, "Now, if you -- you got to understand this." I says, "You got to always have your own band or you got to be a soloist." So I says, "Because when they put some music up, you can't read it." So they wrote him some arrangements and things, so he have to learn him his part. It's a handicap, it's really a handicap. So then like a lot of times, Benny wanted to use him, like with the Basie band, have us both -- but he can't read. So Benny --…
Where does that phrase come from, "Bostons"?
